verdict.rationale: Finix is a hosted payments-infrastructure service. Self-hosting is a fair question for this kind of product, since self-hostable payment platforms exist, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an on-premises, self-hosted or open-source deployment: the docs describe only Finix-run Sandbox and Live accounts, the Dashboard and the APIs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
